description: Applied manually in Cloudflare. Permit verified Applebot search discovery while rejecting impostors and Applebot-Extended training. Keep the existing unrelated scraper blocks.
expression: (http.user_agent contains "Lightpanda") or (http.user_agent contains "ExaSearchBot") or (http.user_agent contains "SemrushBot") or (http.user_agent contains "Sogou") or (http.user_agent contains "Applebot-Extended") or ((http.user_agent contains "Applebot") and not cf.client.bot)
